rules.rationale: This simplification adds the constructor-disjointness fact that a one-element IntSeq is not empty. Stage 1 proves the same fact in the lemma-only definition, but prove.sh compiles and uses this rule in the main proof before running that separate proof, so it does not satisfy the required first-proved ordering for PROVED_DERIVED_LEMMA.
This is the macro expansion defining the named loopBody AST term; it introduces syntax for the exact loop body and does not add an execution or mathematical fact.
This is the macro expansion defining the named solveBody AST term used by the claims; it is a syntactic definition of the exact program body.
This equation defines charAlpha for a one-character modeled string in terms of the existing nonemptiness test and allAlpha helper.
This is the base equation of the alphaAcc recurrence, returning the accumulated alphabetic-character flag when no input remains.
This simplification is the alphabetic recursive equation of the alphaAcc definition; under charAlpha(C) it advances structurally and sets the accumulator to true.
This simplification is the non-alphabetic recursive equation of the alphaAcc definition; under the complementary guard it advances structurally and preserves the accumulator.
This is the base equation of the toggleAcc recurrence, returning the accumulated output when no input remains.
This simplification is the alphabetic recursive equation defining toggleAcc; it appends swapC(C) to the output accumulator and recurses on REST.
This simplification is the complementary non-alphabetic recursive equation defining toggleAcc; it appends C unchanged and recurses on REST.
This is the empty-input base equation defining lastChar as the supplied initial loop-target value.
This is the structural recursive equation defining lastChar by retaining the current character and continuing through REST.
This guarded equation defines the alphabetic-input branch of solveResult using the toggleAcc summary.
This complementary guarded equation defines the no-alphabetic-character branch of solveResult using revIS.
